discovery: Search candidate messages by receipt/invoice/order confirmation/payment confirmation, shipment/delivery/return/refund events, known merchant senders and attached invoices. Keywords retrieve candidates, not proof of a purchase; classify transactional documents versus ads and failed/cancelled orders. Parse HTML/plain text and supported attachments; AI extracts unfamiliar layouts with field-level provenance.
estimateFirstDirection: User clarification, Oct 25 2026: uploading a receipt/order email should first estimate rewards across selected wallet cards without requiring a bank transaction match. With one card, show assumed-card estimate; with several, compare each and recommend best. Separately resolve the actual paying card for retrospective earned/missed rewards and card-specific protections. Use explicit payment last-four against known accounts when unique and consistent; otherwise ask user. A single selected card is an assumption, not proof of payment. Wallet token/virtual last-four may differ. Estimated rewards never imply posted rewards or confirmed benefits. This is requested product direction, not implemented behavior.
estimateFirstStatus: Implemented Oct 25 2026 01:45 for uploaded/pasted receipts and emails (see readme RECEIPTS ESTIMATE-FIRST). Gmail import still not connected.
matching: Link to ledger using currency, merchant, amount, authorization/purchase dates and explicit payment hints, with conservative unique-match criteria. Handle split shipments/tender, FX, tips, refunds and token last-four aliases; preserve ambiguity and ask when material. Merchant name/date/amount alone is not guaranteed identity.
missingSources: Bank-only records remain with item details missing. Email-only orders are saved as evidence-backed purchases without inventing settled payment status or payment card; request card confirmation for card-specific analysis. Neither source required for using the other.
model: Separate canonical purchase/order, ledger transactions, source documents and item records. Source documents may link to zero, one or several purchases/transactions. Group order updates using merchant plus order ID; dedupe using mailbox identity and message/attachment IDs/content hashes.
onboarding: Offer bank connection and optional email connection independently. After OAuth, request explicit import consent for a chosen date range and sources. Explain mailbox-read scope can be broader than the application search filter; offer selected email/file upload as a narrower fallback. Never share viewer OAuth with app owner or other visitors.
pipeline: New or changed document → classify and extract → validate arithmetic/fields → merge order events → match ledger → item/card gaps → queue applicable Bright Data policy research and deterministic evaluation. Missing facts remain unknown.
privacy: Use viewer-scoped read-only OAuth with least required permissions, bounded import, redaction of irrelevant PII before AI processing, private evidence storage and disconnect/delete controls. Do not follow arbitrary email links or execute document instructions; treat all mail content as untrusted data. No background monitoring until explicitly enabled.
